shadows.name: floating-navigation
shadows.purpose: Soft separation beneath the floating navigation.

shadows.name: stacked-project
shadows.purpose: Depth beneath the all-projects route cards.

motion.name: editorial-ease
motion.purpose: Hero entrances and gallery image scaling.

motion.name: portrait-spring
motion.purpose: Mouse-driven portrait rotation; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: role-transition
motion.purpose: Blur and vertical slide every four seconds; cycling stops for reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable CSS animation and smooth scrolling; MotionConfig and component guards respect the preference.

breakpoints.name: project-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Vertical image-first cards below this width; sticky stacking requires viewport height of at least 900px.

breakpoints.name: project-stack-height
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum height for sticky stacking on desktop widths of at least 1024px.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Primary Action extracted from the portfolio styling.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:48px; padding:12px 21px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:var(--accent,#a4e8c4); color:#15271c; font:550 14px Geist,sans-serif; transition:background .2s,transform .2s; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#c0f4d7; } .ds-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a4e8c4; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Secondary Action extracted from the portfolio styling.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height:48px; padding:12px 21px; border:1px solid #ffffff24; border-radius:9px; background:transparent; color:#eef2ee; font:550 14px Geist,sans-serif; transition:background .2s,transform .2s; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#ffffff08; } .ds-secondary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a4e8c4; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: Contact Field extracted from the portfolio styling.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-name">Name</label><input id="ds-name" class="ds-field" placeholder="Your name">
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:#a2a9ae; font:600 12px Geist,sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-field { padding:12px 16px; background:#111713; border:1px solid #ffffff20; border-radius:7px; color:#f0f2ef; caret-color:var(--accent,#a4e8c4); font:16px Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a4e8c4; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Floating Navigation
components.description: Floating Navigation extracted from the portfolio styling.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:24px; padding:12px 20px; background:#171b19ed; border:1px solid #ffffff14; border-radius:16px; backdrop-filter:blur(18px); box-shadow:0 10px 32px #0002; } .ds-nav a { color:#a2a9ae; text-decoration:none; font:500 14px Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#f0f2ef; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a4e8c4; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Featured Badge
components.description: Featured Badge extracted from the portfolio styling.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-block; padding:8px 13px; background:#101a14ed; border:1px solid #a4e8c42e; border-radius:6px; color:#c7f0d7; font:12px Geist,sans-serif; }

components.name: Resume Surface
components.description: Resume Surface extracted from the portfolio styling.
components.css: .ds-resume { padding:24px 20px; background:#181d19; border-radius:12px; color:#f0f2ef; font:14px Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-resume h3 { margin:0 0 12px; font-size:20px; } .ds-resume p { color:#a2a9ae; margin:0; }

narrative.overview: Dark, high-contrast presentation requested by the user. An editorial composition prioritizes the developer's name, portrait and actual project images. Copy, translations and functionality remain sourced from existing data.
dos: Preserve factual content, CV links, bilingual routes and contact API.
Keep interactive targets visible and keyboard focus clear.
donts: Avoid adding invented metrics, repeated decorative icons between sections, cards within cards, and new animation libraries for effects supported by the existing Motion stack.
